caption:
Mr Turtle's shoulder blade clicks every time he rolls his shoulders. It doesn't hurt, but it's hard to stop noticing.

Your shoulder blade glides over the ribcage as you move. Painless clicking is common and usually not a worry. Gentle shoulder blade control work can help it move more smoothly.

Hybi's 1-minute set: sit tall, draw your shoulder blades gently back and down, hold 5 seconds, 10 reps, 2–3 times a day. Stop if pain builds or your arm feels weak.

Clicking with pain, a shoulder blade that sticks out, or clicking that started after an injury is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
